mapper.select: SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.content, a.user_id, b.username, a.form_id, a.status, a.parent_article_id, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM article a LEFT OUTER JOIN site_user b ON a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE article_id=#{articleId}

SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.content, a.user_id, b.username, a.form_id, a.status, a.root_id, a.parent_article_id, (SELECT title FROM article WHERE article_id = a.parent_article_id) AS parent_title, a.sort_order, a.dept, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM article a LEFT OUTER JOIN site_user b ON a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE 1=1
AND a.title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND a.content LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND b.username LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND a.status = #{status}
AND DATE(a.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE
AND a.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND a.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY
a.created_at ASC
a.created_at DESC
(CASE WHEN a.root_id = 0 THEN a.article_id ELSE a.root_id END) DESC, a.sort_order ASC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM article a LEFT OUTER JOIN site_user b ON a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE 1=1
AND a.title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND a.content LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND b.username LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND a.status = #{status}
AND DATE(a.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE
AND a.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND a.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET sort_order = sort_order + 1 WHERE root_id = #{rootId} /* 같은 원문 가족들만 찾아서 */ AND sort_order >= #{sortOrder} /* 내 자리를 포함해 뒤에 있는 글들을 */ AND article_id != #{articleId} /* 한 칸씩 뒤로 밀기 */
UPDATE article SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT form_id as formId, form_name as formName, description, downloadable, created_at as createdAt FROM forms ORDER BY form_id ASC
